name: skc-al-workspace
description: Safe Business Central AL file naming and workspace organization with multi-root support, confirmed bulk actions, and explicit Copilot tools for coding agents.

commands.title: AL Workspace: Organize All AL Files

alWorkspace.onSaveAction.description: Action applied to the exact AL document emitted by the save event.

alWorkspace.fileNamePattern.description: Default file-name pattern for AL objects.

alWorkspace.extensionFileNamePattern.description: Optional file-name pattern for extension objects. Empty uses the default pattern.

alWorkspace.pageCustomizationFileNamePat.description: Optional file-name pattern for page customizations. Empty uses the default pattern.

alWorkspace.organizationMode.description: Folder structure used by reorganize actions.

alWorkspace.sourceRoot.description: Workspace-relative root for reorganized AL files.

alWorkspace.testSourceRoot.description: Optional workspace-relative root for Test and TestRunner codeunits. Empty uses sourceRoot.

alWorkspace.namespacePrefixToIgnore.description: Optional namespace prefix removed before namespace folders are calculated.

alWorkspace.affixesToRemove.description: Prefixes or suffixes removed when rendering <ObjectNameShort>.

alWorkspace.objectNamePrefix.description: Prefix used by naming tokens and optional semantic object-name rewriting.

alWorkspace.objectNameSuffix.description: Suffix used by naming tokens and optional semantic object-name rewriting.

alWorkspace.rewriteObjectName.description: Use the AL language server to add the configured prefix and suffix to the object name and update references. Disabled by default.

languageModelTools.name: skc_al_inspect_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Parses an AL object from an explicit file path and reports its expected file name and organization path without changing files.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect an AL file and report its expected path.

filePath.description: Absolute path to an AL file in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: skc_al_rename_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Safely renames the AL file at an explicit path according to the configured naming pattern. Requires user confirmation and never relies on the active editor.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename an AL file to its configured name.

filePath.description: Absolute path to an AL file in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: skc_al_reorganize_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Safely renames and moves the AL file at an explicit path according to workspace settings. Requires user confirmation and never relies on the active editor.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename and organize an AL file.

filePath.description: Absolute path to an AL file in the workspace.

scripts.package: npm run check:public && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
